en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Twenty-second Chapter
Is it the case that one can attain Arahatship while lying in the womb?
Is the attainment of Arahatship possible for one who is intoxicated, heedless, of confused mindfulness, and lacking clear comprehension?
Certainly not; it should not be so stated… [as before]… Is there the realization of the Dhamma for one who has fallen asleep?
But can it be said that there is a realization of the Dhamma for one who is heedless, negligent, muddled in mindfulness, and lacking clear comprehension?
Certainly not; such a thing should not be said …pe….
Is there the attainment of Arahantship for one who has gone into a dream? Yes.
Is there the attainment of Arahantship for one who is asleep, negligent, muddled in mindfulness, and lacking clear comprehension? No.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … The Discussion on Tissa is finished.
